title: Draft: Shadow Traffic Telemetry Event Schema (v1) + Storage Mapping
content:
Owner: Nadia Rahman (Telemetry pipelines)  |  Reviewers: Logan Wright, Caleb Johnson, Allison Grant  |  Consumers: Console (Dylan/Chloe/Jada), Evals/Scoring (Jonas/Karthik/Selene)

Context
This doc proposes a v1 telemetry event schema for shadow traffic (mirrored requests) and the downstream storage mapping to our analytics tables used by:
- Console “Shadow Experiments” deltas (quality + latency/cost)
- Scoring pipeline (async rubric/heuristics, model-graded)
- SRE dashboards/alerts (shadow lag, error rates, overhead)

Constraints / design principles
1) Fail-open + low overhead: emitting shadow events must not block user path.
2) Cardinality-safe: no unbounded tags (prompt_id/customer_id/freeform headers). Provide coarse dimensions + bucketing.
3) Privacy-first: do not emit raw prompts/responses in telemetry events. Use artifact refs to redacted storage, short retention by default.
4) Deterministic pairing: stable request fingerprinting + bucketing enables control vs shadow comparisons.

Definitions
- Control: the response actually returned to the user.
- Shadow target: candidate variant receiving mirrored request, not user-visible.
- Pair: the logical relationship between the control request and the shadow attempt(s) for that request.

Event model overview (v1)
We emit three logical events:
A) shadow_pair_created_v1  (emitted by router/data plane)
B) shadow_attempt_completed_v1 (emitted by router/data plane when shadow finishes or fails)
C) shadow_score_completed_v1 (emitted by scoring workers)

We intentionally avoid per-token/per-chunk events for streaming (see Streaming section).

Common envelope fields (all events)
Required
- event_name: string (one of the three names)
- event_version: int (1)
- emitted_at: RFC3339 timestamp (UTC)
- tenant_id: string (internal tenant/org ID; must be stable)
- deployment_mode: enum {hosted, dedicated, private}
- region: string (e.g., us-east-1); for private: customer region identifier
- env: enum {prod, staging} (prod only for customer traffic)
- trace_id: string (W3C trace ID if present; else internal request trace)

Optional (strongly controlled)
- request_id: string (internal request id; NOT user-provided)
- route_id: string (stable route identifier, not freeform)
- route_group: string (bucketed route grouping; see Cardinality)
- sdk_language: enum {python, typescript, go, rest, unknown}
- request_type: enum {chat_completions, completions, responses, embeddings, rerank, other}

Pairing + bucketing fields (all events)
Required
- request_fingerprint: string (base64url-encoded 128-bit)
- fingerprint_method: enum {hmac_sha256_v1}
- fingerprint_input_version: int (1)
- bucket_id: string (0..N-1 as string; deterministic bucket)
- shadow_policy_id: string (stable identifier for the shadow policy attached to route/rollout)

Optional
- rollout_id: string (if attached to a rollout/canary)
- experiment_id: string (shadow experiment object id)
- assignment_id: string (variant assignment identifier, if applicable)

Variant/model identity fields
Required
- control_variant_id: string (stable ID; e.g., rollout variant “A”)
- shadow_variant_id: string (stable ID; e.g., rollout variant “B-shadow-1”)
- control_model_id: string (catalog or customer model identifier)
- shadow_model_id: string

Optional (recommended)
- control_model_version: string (opaque version; e.g., “2026-02-01.3”)
- shadow_model_version: string
- control_quant_profile: string (e.g., “fp16”, “int8_kv”, “w4a16”; must be from allowlist)
- shadow_quant_profile: string
- routing_policy_id: string (if multi-policy routing is active)

PII-safe request/response metadata
We do not emit raw prompt/messages/response text.

Required (safe numeric metadata)
- input_tokens_est: int (estimated input tokens)
- control_output_tokens_est: int (estimated output tokens for control)

Optional
- prompt_bytes: int (bytes of serialized prompt/messages)
- prompt_truncated: bool
- input_mime: enum {json, text, unknown}
- has_tools: bool
- has_images: bool
- is_streaming: bool
- max_output_tokens: int

Artifact references (for debug + eval samples)
These are pointers to redacted, access-controlled storage objects. Presence is gated by tenant settings + sampling.

Optional
- input_artifact_ref: string (e.g., “artf_01H…”)  
- control_output_artifact_ref: string (optional; typically off by default)
- shadow_output_artifact_ref: string
- artifact_redaction_profile: string (e.g., “default_v1”, “strict_finserv_v1”)
- artifact_retention_hours: int (effective retention for artifacts)

Latency/cost fields
These are used for overhead analysis and cost modeling.

Optional
- control_latency_ms: int
- shadow_latency_ms: int
- shadow_queue_delay_ms: int (if shadow dispatch is queued)
- shadow_timeout_ms: int
- control_compute_ms: int (if available)
- shadow_compute_ms: int
- control_cost_microusd: int
- shadow_cost_microusd: int

Outcome + error fields
Required for shadow_attempt_completed_v1
- shadow_outcome: enum {success, timeout, cancelled, target_error, policy_blocked, circuit_open, dropped_backpressure}

Optional
- shadow_http_status: int
- shadow_error_class: enum {none, network, upstream_5xx, upstream_4xx, ratelimit, auth, invalid_request, internal}
- shadow_error_code: string (stable internal code; NOT freeform message)
- shadow_retry_count: int
- circuit_breaker_state: enum {closed, open, half_open}

Scoring fields (shadow_score_completed_v1)
Required
- scoring_job_id: string
- rubric_bundle_id: string (e.g., “quality_default_v1”)
- rubric_bundle_version: string (e.g., “1.2.0”)
- score_target: enum {shadow_only, control_and_shadow}
- score_outcome: enum {success, skipped_missing_artifacts, skipped_policy, worker_error, timeout}

Optional
- score_latency_ms: int
- score_artifact_ref: string (pointer to detailed per-metric results)
- metrics_included: string (comma-separated allowlisted metric IDs)
- metric_refusal_rate: float (0..1)  [NOTE: floats stored as strings in some sinks; see Storage]
- metric_format_adherence: float (0..1)
- metric_instruction_following: float (0..1)
- metric_safety_flags: string (comma-separated enum flags; allowlist)
- score_warnings: string (short; capped length)

NOTE on metric fields:
- For v1, we prefer “score_artifact_ref” + a small number of headline metrics inline.
- Console aggregates should read from the normalized scores table (see below), not from wide event payloads.

Event-specific schemas

A) shadow_pair_created_v1
Purpose: Declare the existence of a control request eligible for shadowing + the intended shadow target(s). This event is emitted once per (request_fingerprint, shadow_variant_id).
Required fields beyond common:
- sampling_rate_permille: int (0..1000)
- shadow_dispatch_mode: enum {inline_mirror, async_mirror}

Optional:
- shadow_target_region: string (if different from control)
- shadow_target_pool: string (bucketed pool name)

B) shadow_attempt_completed_v1
Purpose: Record the completion/failure for a single shadow attempt.
Required beyond common:
- attempt_id: string
- shadow_outcome: enum (see above)

Optional:
- shadow_latency_ms, shadow_http_status, shadow_error_*, retry_count
- shadow_output_tokens_est: int
- shadow_output_artifact_ref: string

C) shadow_score_completed_v1
Purpose: Record scoring completion and link back to the pair/attempt.
Required beyond common:
- scoring_job_id
- attempt_id (or stable attempt reference)
- score_outcome
- rubric_bundle_id, rubric_bundle_version

Optional:
- score_artifact_ref
- headline metrics (limited set)

Idempotency + dedupe
We expect at-least-once delivery from data plane emitters. All consumers must dedupe using:
- dedupe_key = tenant_id + request_fingerprint + shadow_variant_id + attempt_id + event_name + event_version
- For shadow_pair_created_v1 (no attempt_id), use: tenant_id + request_fingerprint + shadow_variant_id + event_name + event_version

Cardinality guardrails (MUST)
Hard rules (drop/normalize at emitter):
- Do not emit: customer-provided headers, user IDs, prompt IDs, raw tool names, freeform “tags”.
- route_id must be a stable internal ID; additionally emit route_group (bucketed) for safe breakdowns.
- model_id/model_version must be from allowlisted catalog IDs or customer-registered IDs; no arbitrary strings.
- error_code must be from internal allowlist; error_message must be dropped.

Soft rules (cap/limit):
- trace_id: ok (high cardinality but used for sampling/debug; not used for dashboard grouping)
- request_id: ok (same)
- artifact refs: ok (not used as a dimension)

Streaming behavior (v1)
- is_streaming=true is emitted on all events for streaming requests.
- We do NOT emit per-chunk telemetry.
- shadow_output_artifact_ref may point to: (a) final assembled output if completed, or (b) partial capture if timeout. In partial case, include shadow_outcome=timeout and shadow_output_tokens_est for captured portion.

Storage mapping (analytics)
We store these events as raw JSON in the ingestion lake, then normalize into two primary tables for queries.

1) analytics.shadow_pairs_v1  (pair/attempt-level)
Grain: one row per shadow attempt (attempt_id). Includes stable dims for aggregation.
Source events: shadow_pair_created_v1 + shadow_attempt_completed_v1 (joined by tenant_id/request_fingerprint/shadow_variant_id; attempt_id from attempt_completed)

Columns (proposed)
- event_date (YYYY-MM-DD; partition)
- emitted_at (timestamp)
- tenant_id
- deployment_mode
- region
- env
- route_id
- route_group
- request_type
- is_streaming
- request_fingerprint
- bucket_id
- shadow_policy_id
- rollout_id
- experiment_id
- assignment_id
- control_variant_id
- shadow_variant_id
- control_model_id
- shadow_model_id
- control_model_version
- shadow_model_version
- control_quant_profile
- shadow_quant_profile
- sampling_rate_permille
- attempt_id
- shadow_outcome
- shadow_http_status
- shadow_error_class
- shadow_error_code
- shadow_retry_count
- control_latency_ms
- shadow_latency_ms
- shadow_timeout_ms
- input_tokens_est
- control_output_tokens_est
- shadow_output_tokens_est
- control_cost_microusd
- shadow_cost_microusd
- input_artifact_ref
- shadow_output_artifact_ref
- artifact_redaction_profile
- artifact_retention_hours

Notes
- This table is the primary source for: shadow success rate, shadow error rate, latency deltas, cost deltas, scoring coverage denominators.

2) analytics.shadow_scores_v1  (score-level, normalized)
Grain: one row per (attempt_id, metric_id). (We can also maintain a wide “headline” table for convenience, but normalized is canonical.)
Source event: shadow_score_completed_v1 + dereferenced score_artifact_ref output.

Columns (proposed)
- event_date (partition)
- emitted_at
- tenant_id
- experiment_id
- rollout_id
- route_id
- route_group
- request_type
- request_fingerprint
- attempt_id
- control_variant_id
- shadow_variant_id
- control_model_id
- shadow_model_id
- rubric_bundle_id
- rubric_bundle_version
- score_outcome
- scoring_job_id
- metric_id (allowlisted string; e.g., “refusal_rate”, “format_adherence”, “instruction_following”)
- metric_value (DOUBLE)
- metric_unit (enum {ratio, score_0_1, boolean, count})
- metric_weight (DOUBLE; optional)
- metric_notes (string; capped)

Notes
- Confidence intervals / deltas are computed in query layer or pre-aggregates, not stored on this table.

3) raw.shadow_events_json_v1  (debug/audit)
Grain: one row per ingested event payload (append-only).
- Use for backfills and incident debugging.
- Retention: longer than artifacts, shorter than core request logs; exact policy in security doc.

Artifact storage (non-analytics)
Artifacts are stored in redacted object storage with strict access controls.
- Keyed by artifact_ref (artf_*)
- Encryption: tenant-scoped keys (Hosted/Dedicated) / customer-managed keys (Private when configured)
- Default retention: 24–72 hours (tenant configurable; Dedicated/Private may override)

Open questions / TODOs
1) Do we need a stable “shadow_target_id” separate from shadow_variant_id (for multi-region/multi-pool)? Ravi suggests yes for routing debug; Allison worries about cardinality. Proposal: include shadow_target_region + shadow_target_pool (bucketed) only.
2) Control output artifacts: default off; but some evals benefit from scoring control+shadow. If we enable control scoring, we need control_output_artifact_ref gated to an additional sampling rate and strict retention.
3) Fingerprint inputs (ENG-5403): final list must avoid including raw prompt text. Current proposal: HMAC(tenant_id + route_id + canonicalized request JSON with redacted message content + stable tool schema hash + max_output_tokens + request_type). This yields stable pairing without storing sensitive content.
4) Metric field strategy: keep wide headline metrics in event vs always normalize via score_artifact_ref. Current plan: allow 3–6 headline floats inline + normalized table for everything else.
5) Private deployments: if analytics DB is local-only, we need a local table schema that matches these columns and a SIEM export mapping (Kevin Osei to advise).

Next steps
- Align with ADR “shadow metrics data model and cardinality” and update this draft to match any decisions.
- Emitter implementation review: Vikram (data plane) + Benji (control plane) confirm feasibility and overhead.
- Add validation tests: ensure error_code allowlist + route_group bucketing + artifact ref gating.
- Publish final schema to a versioned location + generate code (structs) for emitters/consumers.
